spec.description: Get information about the assets that are available for deposit, withdrawal, trading and earn.

asset.description: Comma delimited list of assets to get info on (optional, default all available assets).

aclass.description: Filters the asset class to retrieve: `currency` (spot currency pairs) or `tokenized_asset` (xstocks).

assetVersion.description: Controls whether response keys and asset identifier fields use Kraken's internal names or display names. Omitted (default): internal names are used, asset keys use the legacy `X`/`Z`-prefixed format (`XXBT`, `ZUSD`). `assetVersion=1`: display names are used, asset keys become their canonical display names (`BTC`, `USD`). Only `assetVersion=1` is currently supported. The `altname` field is not affected by this parameter.

response.description: Asset id (or display name, per `assetVersion`) mapped to its info.

decimals.description: Number of decimal places for record keeping amounts of this asset.

display_decimals.description: Number of decimal places shown for display purposes in frontends.

collateral_value.description: Valuation as margin collateral, if applicable.

margin_rate.description: Interest rate charged when borrowing this asset for margin trading, as a decimal string.
